_comment: Parts factory pilot 1 (FACTORY_WORKFLOW v0.1, author 6. 10. 2026): the corridor frame module - portal ring, its foot lights and the floor plates between two portals. Step 2 drawing data, read by Tools/Design/draw_part_sheet.py. Lengths in metres in the layout frame (x along the run, y across, z up from the deck); the profile detail in millimetres. Sections from ArtSource/Kit/kit_rules.json.
title: Rámový modul chodby – portál, patky se světlem, podlahová deska

profile._comment: Cross-section of the ring member, u along the run (0..300 mm), v from the wall panel face into the corridor (0 = panel face, + = into the room). Steps: the base, step 2, the crown; a polished lip on the crown's edges, the ribbed cuff in the crown's middle; the hidden strip behind step 2 on the top member only.

lip._comment: on both crown edges, wrapping the 12 mm chamfer

protrusion_by_section._N: N: step 2 and the crown 10 mm shallower each (base 0-40, step 40-60, crown 60-80)

hidden_strip._comment: LED strip in the shadow of step 2, washing the crown down; only on the top member

lights.name: patka
lights.housing: osmiboké 150 × 150 mm, hloubka 60 mm, difuzor 90 × 50 mm rýhovaný
lights.where: u paty pilíře, z 0,02–0,17 m, čelo 30 mm za lícem koruny

lights.name: horní roh
lights.housing: kruhové Ø 60 mm, hloubka 40 mm, v zalomení šikminy a vybrání
lights.where: W z 2,10 m, N z 2,10 m

lights.name: skrytá lišta
lights.housing: lišta 12 mm ve stínu stupně 2, zdroj není z oka vidět
lights.reach: přechod jasu na koruně shora dolů

floor._comment: Between portals: octagonal plates 0.9 m long and transverse bands 0.3 m; short pitch = portal + plate, long pitch = portal + plate + band + plate. W: the centre plate 1.2 wide plus side plates to the plinth; N: the centre plate only.

threshold._comment: The floor inside the portal module: a plain tread plate 0.3 m with the lip, the foot light housings at its ends.

eye._fov: nejistě: FOV ze SC dodá autor
